d.seg: हाँ तो अपना व्हाट्सएप नंबर बोलो
d.tr: Yes, so tell me your WhatsApp number
d.j: The user is explicitly asking for a WhatsApp number to move the conversation to an external platform.

d.seg: आप अपना बोलो मैं आपको मैसेज डालती हूँ ठीक है
d.tr: You tell yours, I will send you a message, okay?
d.j: The user is offering to share contact information to move the conversation to an external platform.
